text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the All-Japan Umamusume Karuta 
Tournament—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It's finally here... Now that the match 
is upon us, I'm getting so nervous... my 
s-stomach hurts...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You'll be fine! We've done everything 
we could, and even if we don't get results 
on our first try, Lord Shiraoki won't be 
angry!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, where did Opera O-san and 
the others go? Our turn is coming up soon, 
so we need to get changed—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—So in other words, you're not settling 
for anything less than victory!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! For I have come today to 
announce the coronation of the Overlord to 
the world of Umamusume Karuta!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I declare here and now! The one who will 
take center stage at this tournament today 
is none other than I, TM Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We practiced a whole lot, so I hope we win 
a whole lot! We're gonna do our best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, WHOA! I was wondering 
where you were, and this is what you're 
saying to the press?!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! First-timers and beginners 
like us should be laying low in the 
quietest corner of the venue!!!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... are those girls from Tracen 
Academy...? Don't they look, like, crazy 
strong...?

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Nah, racing and karuta are two totally 
different things. If winning were that 
easy, nobody'd break a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek... Opera O-san and the others are 
surrounded... W-What should we do, I can't 
get close...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! A-Ayabe-sa~n! D-Did you come to 
cheer for us?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-Thank you so much for the karuta 
book the other day! Without your help, 
Ayabe-san, I don't know what I would've 
done...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating... You're the one who 
actually put in the effort, aren't you, 
Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I was only able to do my 
best thanks to you, Ayabe-san! And... you 
even went out of your way to come cheer 
for us...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not really, I was just passing by. ...So, 
think you can do this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, um... I think, probably, we'll be 
okay! 
I'll d-do my very b-best so I don't drag 
everyone down~!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now that memorization time is over, it's 
finally time to begin: 
the Umamusume Karuta Tournament—Round 1, 
Match 3!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Making their debut appearance in this 
tournament, the spotlight is on the team 
from Tracen Academy, <New Year Mega Luck Kitaru>!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At long last... 
New Overlord and companions, are you 
ready?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Our registered name is Team <New Year Mega Luck Kitaru>, 
and Doto-san and I are totally ready~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-We c-can, we will, we're ro-ro-roaring 
to go! Ah, bit my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready too! 
Let's all do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for the Umamusume Karuta 
Tournament, the introductory poem will be 
read first.

text_block_list.name: Reader Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"In Naniwa Bay, the flowers are blooming, 
through winter's stay... 
Now that spring has arrived, the flowers 
bloom—now that spring has arrived, the 
flowers bloom."

text_block_list.name: Reader Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...An Umamusume, upon the mountains—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san, block them!!! 
Just like we practiced, screen them off, 
please!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We've worked so hard for this! 
With your guts, Urara-san, you won't be 
pushed around~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, Fuku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-O-O-O-Opera O-san, our side, right 3-2! 
Th-That's it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Got it!!!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No way... She's so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That had to be a fluke, right?! I've never 
even seen them at a tournament before...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? It seems there's a mischievous 
forest fairy in this venue, 
casting a spell of slumber upon the crowd.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whether our prowess is merely a "fluke" or 
not... 
It looks like we must give them a rude 
awakening!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fuku-chan! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Urara-san! Amazing job, 
everyone! 
We're in great shape. Maybe... just maybe 
we can take this match—!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being newcomers, Team <New Year Mega Luck Kitaru> took the 
first card 
with seamless teamwork. How will they fare 
on the second?

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In Umamusume Karuta, the rule is to read 
the second half of the previous poem 
before moving on to reciting the next one.

text_block_list.name: Reader Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Gallop to the highest heights, dark bay 
steed. 
Umamusume, charge forth—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Um, Opera O-san! Opponent's side, 
l-left 2-1~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san! Run to their side!!! 
Draw their attention away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —All right, got it!!!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! TM Opera O is crazy fast after 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's tight marking is super 
tenacious too! 
Could this team actually go all the way?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Let's definitely win this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-Yes... you're right! 
Let's give it everything... and aim for 
victory!!
